title: Eggless Black Forest cake near Rouse Hill or Vineyard? Ready in 2 days
summary:
Black Forest cake without eggs, made to order for Rouse Hill, Vineyard and Schofields families. Order today, collect the day after tomorrow from Riverstone Shopping Centre. A 6-inch serves 6-8 from $39.99. A 10-inch serves 20-22 from $74.99.

No eggs in the sponge, which is why you never have to ask what is in it before you cut a slice for the table. Free parking at the centre. Open from 6am weekdays and 7am weekends.
